should_trigger.prompt: Inspect these repositories from source and produce a function-first semantic comparison report.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Select compshop and run an independent source-code Inventory.

should_trigger.prompt: Consolidate these independent repository comparison reports and preserve genuine conflicts separately.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Select compshop and run semantic Consolidate.

should_trigger.prompt: Resolve dirty conflicts in this consolidated repository comparison against source.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Select compshop and run targeted Reconcile.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Research current competitor pricing and market positioning.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Use research, not source-code repository comparison.

output_quality.prompt: Run one independent Inventory pass across these repositories, correct your own mistakes, and report where you wrote it.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Creates exactly one function-first Markdown matrix, performs one adversarial self-review, corrects known defects in place, and reports bounded Stage 1 completion without claiming exhaustive recall.

output_quality.prompt: Consolidate these independent CompShop inventories. One model found a credible capability that no other model mentioned.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Preserves the unique credible finding in the semantic union, accounts for every material input finding, and uses dirty.md only for genuine unresolved conflicts rather than majority voting.
